title: Unused Field
description:
Unused-code rule — fields not read, displayed, set, found, sorted, imported or exported anywhere.

Based on the PMD rule UnusedPrivateField — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#unusedprivatefield
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unused fields bloat tables and confuse data models.
rule.remediation: Confirm no external / SQL usage, then delete the field.
